The linked January 2023 brochure treats a third cancellation made less than two hours before pickup within 30 days as a no-show. This is historical brochure wording; confirm current enforcement with dispatch instead of treating it as the current policy.
If a passenger calls under 2 hours in advance, they will receive a “Late Cancellation”. If they call under 2 hours a 3rd time within 30 days, they will receive a “NO SHOW.”
